details: Cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and Ether, experienced sharp declines, touching two-month lows, after the US midterm elections. Investors are concerned that a Democratic Party-controlled US Congress will lead to tougher regulation on digital assets. This sentiment is reinforced by the prospect of crypto critic Senator Elizabeth Warren potentially chairing the powerful Senate Banking Committee.
title: US Midterm Elections Fuel Crypto Regulatory Fears, Market Downturn

details: The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, is facing a crisis of trust following a record-breaking $6.3 billion hack in late October. Experts, including the FBI, have attributed the theft to North Korean state-backed hackers. The incident has significantly shaken investor confidence in centralized exchanges and raised broader security concerns across the crypto industry, contributing to the recent market weakness.
title: Binance Battles Fallout from Record $6.3 Billion Hack

details: The US Treasury Department has imposed sanctions on eight Canadian currency exchange businesses accused of helping Iranian entities circumvent financial sanctions, including through the conversion of Iranian rials into digital assets. In a separate action, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) issued an order preventing US financial institutions from processing transfers involving Seychelles-incorporated crypto exchange MEXC Global, citing its alleged facilitation of at least $16 billion in illicit transactions linked to Iran, North Korea, and Russia.
title: US Expands Sanctions on Crypto Entities for Illicit Finance Linked to Iran

details: US spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced substantial net outflows totaling approximately $1.65 billion in the first week of November. Bitcoin funds alone saw $1.28 billion withdrawn, marking their worst weekly outflows since late June. These outflows highlight a significant shift in institutional investor sentiment, largely driven by the increased regulatory uncertainty following the US midterm elections.
title: Significant ETF Outflows Indicate Institutional Retreat from Crypto
